# layout

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">Layout</span> <a class="api-badge" href="https://github.com/FrSkyRC/ETHOS-Feedback-Community/tree/HEAD/lua/examples/layout">view on GitHub</a></div>

Register a custom screen layout (`system.registerLayout`).

Install: copy the folder to `SCRIPTS:/layout/` on the radio (or the simulator's `scripts/` folder) and restart.

```lua title="main.lua" linenums="1"
-- Lua Layout example

local function init()
  system.registerLayout({key="XL+3", widgets={
    {x=8, y=95, w=784, h=248},
    {x=8, y=351, w=256, h=56},
    {x=272, y=351, w=256, h=56},
    {x=536, y=351, w=256, h=56}
  }})
end

return {init=init}
```
